etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from Anglo-Norman amenable, amesnable, from amener (“to bring or lead, fetch in or to”) +‎ -able (“-able”); amener is in turn from a- + mener (“to lead, conduct”), from Late Latin mināre (“to drive”), Latin deponent minārī (“to threaten, menace”).
senses: Willing to respond to persuasion or suggestions.
